fusions.name: Short-Changed
fusions.desc: Throws a crescent that deals 4 damage. 20% of the damage it deals comes back to you as healing over the following 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Misplaced Trust
fusions.desc: Sweeps a full circle that deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, with a 50% chance to confuse each for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on a target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Lost in the Stubble
fusions.desc: Veils you for 7 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later and you move 17% faster. You restore 6 health when you use it. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Sticky Fingers
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
